capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeService
capabilities.description: Runtime task lifecycle service for the ``runtime.task_runtime`` cell.

methods.name: create_task_row
methods.doc: Create a task and return the runtime row projection with event evidence.

methods.name: get_task
methods.doc: Return the task-runtime observable read model for a single task row.

methods.name: update_task_row
methods.doc: Update a task and return the runtime row projection with event evidence.

methods.name: reopen_task_row
methods.doc: Reopen a task and return the runtime row projection with event evidence.

methods.name: list_observable_task_rows
methods.doc: Return task rows for read-only runtime projections.

methods.name: claim_next_execution
methods.doc: Atomically select and claim the next executable task.

methods.name: list_ready_task_rows
methods.doc: Return ready rows after the compatibility dependency refresh.

methods.name: get_task_row_stats
methods.doc: Compatibility entrypoint for observable task-row status counts.

capabilities.name: FenceExpiredFactoryRunSessionsCommandV1
capabilities.description: Fence expired active sessions before Factory stale-owner recovery.

capabilities.name: ExpiredFactoryRunSessionFenceResultV1
capabilities.description: Typed, observation-safe result of expired-session fencing.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return a detached UTF-8 JSON-compatible control-plane record.

capabilities.name: BindRuntimeTaskToFactoryRunCommandV1
capabilities.description: Bind one canonical TaskRuntime row to one Factory portfolio run.

capabilities.name: RuntimeTaskFactoryRunBindingResultV1
capabilities.description: Typed outcome for write-once Factory portfolio-run binding.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return a detached JSON-serializable control-plane record.

capabilities.name: PrepareOwnerReworkExecutionCommandV1
capabilities.description: Request TaskRuntime preparation after TaskMarket has granted a claim.

capabilities.name: OwnerReworkExecutionPreparationResultV1
capabilities.description: Typed outcome of TaskRuntime's owner-rework execution preparation.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return an observation-safe, JSON-serializable result projection.

capabilities.name: ObservableTaskRowsProjectionV1
capabilities.description: Observable TaskRuntime rows with explicit authority provenance.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.doc: Return a detached transport projection for HTTP and audit consumers.

methods.name: rows_for_factory_run
methods.doc: Return detached rows bound exactly to one Factory portfolio run.

methods.name: to_authority_dict
methods.doc: Return the compact authority surface used by control-plane gates.

capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeExecutionFactV1
capabilities.description: Immutable typed projection for one ``task_runtime.execution`` fact.

methods.name: from_payload
methods.doc: Validate and detach the service-layer execution projection.

methods.name: terminal
methods.doc: Return whether this fact carries a terminal execution verdict.

methods.name: idempotency_key
methods.doc: Return the stable FactStream key for this event projection.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return the backward-compatible flat fact payload.

capabilities.name: SettleTaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptCommandV1
capabilities.description: Request the one canonical terminal settlement for a claimed attempt.

capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptSettlementVerdictV1
capabilities.description: Typed result for a one-winner execution-attempt settlement.

capabilities.name: HeartbeatTaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptCommandV1
capabilities.description: Request one bounded, identity-fenced TaskRuntime lease renewal.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return a detached, JSON-serializable heartbeat command record.

capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptHeartbeatVerdictV1
capabilities.description: Typed outcome for one bounded TaskRuntime execution-attempt heartbeat.

methods.name: reason
methods.doc: Expose the stable failure/success reason expected by consumers.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return a detached, JSON-serializable heartbeat verdict record.

capabilities.name: ValidateTaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptQueryV1
capabilities.description: Request a read-only validation of a persisted execution attempt.

capabilities.name: OpenTaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptAuthorityCommandV1
capabilities.description: Request read-only opening of a process-local authority for one attempt.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return a detached UTF-8 JSON-compatible open request record.

capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptValidationVerdictV1
capabilities.description: Fail-closed, read-only authority verdict for one execution attempt.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return a detached, JSON-serializable validation result.

capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeExecutionAttemptAuthorityOpenVerdictV1
capabilities.description: Typed, non-durable authority-open result for a validated attempt.

methods.name: to_record
methods.doc: Return UTF-8 JSON-compatible evidence without serializing authority.

capabilities.name: RuntimeTaskRuntimeError
capabilities.description: Raised when `runtime.task_runtime` contract processing fails.
